svg.title: Human insulin: two folded chains from PDB 1TRZ
svg.desc: Original projection of 399 deposited heavy-atom coordinates. Chain A, gold, has 21 amino acids; chain B, cyan, has 30. Sticks show chemical connections, including three sulfur-to-sulfur bonds. Six unresolved side-chain atoms and hydrogens are absent. One molecule is selected from a crystal hexamer; water, ions and other chains are omitted. Symbols are illustrative, not measured surfaces. Coordinate data: RCSB PDB 1TRZ, CC0; Ciszak and Smith, 1994, doi:10.1021/bi00172a030.
svg.metadata: Source: https://files.rcsb.org/download/1TRZ.cif; SHA-256: c09212b60ec05abc195ded6a30f630877eb00ee186b797133543c2d34aef3b45; retrieved 2026-11-05. Deterministic projection generated by assets/models/derive.py.
svg.text: 399 deposited heavy atoms · PDB 1TRZ · static projection
Atoms are shown as dots; sticks show chemical connections.
